entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr
observations: The 466-residue query protein shows 42.8% identity over 100% coverage to reviewed Helicobacter pylori Nnr P56176, E-value 3.98e-110.
Homolog annotations assign bifunctional NAD(P)HX epimerase and ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydratase activities.
The query has YjeF_N domain PF03853 at positions 24-175 and Carb_kinase domain PF01256 at positions 235-451.
Reviewed homologs report binding of one K+ ion per subunit.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX epimerization
observations: NAD(P)HX repair enzyme Nnr catalyzes interconversion of (6R)- and (6S)-NADHX and separately of (6R)- and (6S)-NADPHX.
Rhea mappings are RHEA:32215 for NADHX and RHEA:32227 for NADPHX epimerization.

entities.name: ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydration
observations: Nnr catalyzes dehydration of (6S)-NADHX using ADP, producing AMP, phosphate, NADH, and H+; Rhea RHEA:32223.
Nnr catalyzes dehydration of (6S)-NADPHX using ADP, producing AMP, phosphate, NADPH, and H+; Rhea RHEA:32235.

entities.name: Potassium cofactor
observations: Reviewed Nnr homologs bind one potassium ion per subunit.
